label: Resolvase Schlafen system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses a genome-encoded, resolvase-associated prokaryotic Schlafen nuclease locus.
observations: Resolvase-associated Schlafen branch under phage defense system; distinct from individual Schlafen proteins, individual prokaryotic schlafen genes, non-resolvase Schlafen nuclease architectures, general resolvase activity, and the DefenseFinder Resolvase_Schlafen source key outside a complete organism-level system.
